title: console: a bare-string CEL predicate (nav `visible`, page `visibleWhen`) runs on the legacy evaluator and fails, though the spec defines a bare string as CEL shorthand
body:
domain:devx#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcVkGJizGH7raJHhAvL

Filing gate: ① a product defect. A QA run met it on two item clauses (studio-authoring.app-and-nav-properties acceptance[3], and studio-authoring.authored-page-slots-and-variables acceptance[1] / negative[0]).

## Reproduction A: app navigation `visible`
1. Boot the showcase. Create a writable package (`POST /api/v1/packages {"manifest":{"id":"com.qa.rnine","name":"QA R9","version":"0.1.0","type":"app","namespace":"qnine"}}`), an object `qnine_note`, and an app whose `navigation` holds `{"type":"object","id":"nav_admin_only","label":"Admin Only Entry","objectName":"qnine_note","visible":"'org_owner' in current_user.positions"}` (`PUT /api/v1/meta/app/APP?mode=draft&package=com.qa.rnine`). Then `POST /api/v1/packages/com.qa.rnine/publish-drafts`. Studio's menu-entry inspector (VISIBLE WHEN) writes exactly this bare string and labels it "Valid CEL".
2. As the seeded admin, whose `GET /api/v1/auth/get-session` positions include `org_owner`, open the app.
3. Expected: the entry is shown to the admin and hidden from a member without that position.
4. Actual: the entry is hidden from everyone. The console logs `[ObjectUI] A visibility predicate could not be evaluated - node "app-shell:visible" … Unexpected token "i" at position 12`.
5. Control: the same source as an envelope, `{"dialect":"cel","source":"'org_owner' in current_user.positions"}`, is shown to the admin and hidden from the member.

## Reproduction B: page block `visibleWhen`
1. In the same package: `PUT /api/v1/meta/page/qnine_vars_page2?mode=draft&package=com.qa.rnine` with `{"type":"app","variables":[{"name":"items","type":"array","defaultValue":["a"]}],"regions":[{"name":"main","components":[{"type":"element:text","id":"b_items","visibleWhen":"size(page.items) > 0","properties":{"content":"VAR-ITEMS array nonempty"}}]}]}`, then publish.
2. Open `/_console/apps/com.qa.rnine/page/qnine_vars_page2`.
3. Expected: "VAR-ITEMS array nonempty" renders.
4. Actual: the block is absent. Console: `Failed to evaluate expression "size(page.items) > 0": "size" is not a function`. The envelope control renders it.

Both reproduced at least twice on fresh loads.

## Mechanism
`ui/packages/core/src/evaluator/ExpressionEvaluator.ts` ~L363–368 routes only an explicit `{ dialect: 'cel' }` envelope to the CEL engine; "Bare strings and `${…}` templates stay on the legacy path (back-compat deprecation window)". The spec's `EvaluatedExpressionInputSchema` defines a bare string as CEL shorthand, the metadata door serves the stored bare string without normalizing it, and Studio authors the bare string. CEL-only syntax (`in`, `size()`) therefore faults on the legacy grammar and fails closed. Fix either side: normalize to the envelope at the door or the loader, or route bare strings in CEL-declared slots to CEL.
